STI — Industrial Networking
STI-288DGGPM
8-port PoE+ industrial switch with native DI/DO/RS485 I/O and dual 1G/2.5G SFP uplinks — 240W total PoE budget.
Key Differentiators
Native DI/DO/RS485 — no external serial gateway needed
Removable 8-pin terminal block integrates digital input (12–30V), digital output (relay/pulse, 2A@30VDC), and RS485 Modbus RTU over TCP/IP. Connect PLCs, RTUs, meters, and field sensors directly to your IP network — one device, not two.
Dual 1G/2.5G SFP uplinks with ≤20ms ERPS ring failover
Multi-rate SFP slots run 1GBase-X or 2.5GBase-X on the same hardware — adapts to existing 1G infrastructure and 2.5G backbone upgrades without device replacement. G.8032 ERPS ring protection recovers in ≤20ms.
8× PoE+ with per-port watchdog and power scheduling
All 8 RJ45 ports deliver up to 30W (IEEE 802.3af/at), 240W total. Per-port PD watchdog, power priority, and scheduling enable unattended fault recovery in unmanned deployments.
